title: Interface to the FWS NWRSpecies Occurrence Database API
text: nwrspeciesr R interface U.S. Fish Wildlife Service National Wildlife Refuge System species occurrence database (NWRSpecies, formerly FWSpecies). provides functions retrieve refuge species lists related lookup values public NWRSpecies web services. Current functionality (read-) includes: get_species_list(): retrieve species occurrence records, optional filters region, refuge, taxonomic category, occurrence, ITIS TSN. download_species_list(): retrieve full species list via CSV download endpoint (useful pulling records single call). get_species_categories(): list valid taxonomic category values. get_species_occurrences(): list valid occurrence values. public SpeciesListBasic method currently exposed API. Sensitive species records Draft status never returned. Functions create edit records planned future release, pending availability corresponding web service.

text: Initial release. Provides read-R interface U.S. Fish Wildlife Service NWRSpecies (formerly FWSpecies) occurrence database.

title: nwrspeciesr 0.1.0
text: get_species_list() retrieves refuge species occurrence records public SpeciesList/items endpoint, optional filters region, refuge, taxonomic category, occurrence, ITIS TSN, plus sorting pagination. download_species_list() retrieves records CSV DownloadFile endpoint, documented way pull records single call combined large rows_per_page. get_species_categories() get_species_occurrences() return valid category occurrence values accepted API. get_refuges() retrieves live refuge name / unit code crosswalk FWS Unit REST API via suggested fwsunitr package.

title: nwrspeciesr 0.1.0
text: get_species_list() download_species_list() accept refuge_name argument alternative refuge_code. Matching case-insensitive tolerant common variants (e.g. “Kenai”, “kenai nwr”, “Kenai National Wildlife Refuge”). Names match one refuge (e.g. “Yukon”, matching Yukon Delta Yukon Flats) return informative error listing candidates. bundled refuges crosswalk used default; custom live table may supplied via crosswalk argument.
